data.name: Verdict of Exorcism
data.description: While using judgment, you can unleash the verdict of exorcism on a creature. When you do, your judgment ends, but the creature is dazed for 1 round (Will DC %1 negates); if the creature is possessed, the possessing entity must succeed at a Will saving throw (DC %1), or be exorcised and never again allowed in that same body.|VerdictOfExorcismDC
